title: @types/form-data is deprecated
summary: npm marks @types/form-data as deprecated: "This is a stub types definition. form-data provides its own type definitions, so you do not need this installed."

constraints: @types/form-data only declares types; form-data now ships its own declarations, so no conflicting ambient definition may remain.

steps.title: Remove the stub types package
steps.instructions: Remove @types/form-data from devDependencies and any explicit reference to it, such as a tsconfig.json compilerOptions.types entry.

steps.title: Use the bundled declarations
steps.instructions: Keep form-data on a version that ships its own type definitions and import its types from form-data.

verification.purpose: Type-check and build with form-data's own declarations.
